data: Which of the lines on the graph for (a) IMDb represent a model named CNN?

The question asks which line on the graph for (a) IMDb represents a model named CNN. From the caption, we know that the lines correspond to different models: yellow for CNN, blue for LSTM, and red for BERTbase. In the graph for (a) IMDb, the yellow line is the highest among all three lines across the entire range of the x-axis. Therefore, the yellow line represents the CNN model.
